directAnswer.en: This is a floor, bedding or screed condition. Type 511 prints particle ≤6 mm, 3 m³/h and hose 32/38 mm. It needs 380 V. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 511 at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine, which prints 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
